answer: Each agent registers a TPM/SGX enclave, whose zero-knowledge attestation binds a hardware key to a relic state-tree leaf; a vine hash anchor and echo consensus contract reject reused measurements and replayed proofs. Forging identities requires compromising distinct enclave silicon and producing valid attestations, while registration bonds follow an O(N^2) quadratic curve and are irreversibly slashed on equivocation, making Sybil expansion superlinear.
